sections.Description:
Players will battle walkers and survive key scenes from The Walking Dead in an immersive physical pinball experience like none other.

Through the iconic Prison, Well Walker, and Blood Bath Multiballs and the depth of each Dead Feature mode (Barn, CDC, Riot, Tunnel, and Arena), players are immersed in a pinball battle that can ultimately leave a “Last Man Standing”… that is, if you’re able to survive the Horde and escape Terminus along your adventure.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Fire the Crossbow!: Take down walkers with the motorized "Crossbow" ball firing mechanism, launching pinballs across the playfield."
- Shoot the Prison: Interactive prison building with mechanically actuated target doors and Walker bash toy target inside "Cell Block C".
- Illuminated Zombie Heads.: Survive the mechanically animated bash toy with playfield magnet, capable of catching and throwing the ball with special effects.
sections.Editions:
Premium:
- Custom audio call-outs from actors Michael Rooker (Merle) and Danai Gurira (Michonne).
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.
- Premium Edition translite and side cabinet highlighting Walking Dead artwork.

Limited Edition:
- Custom laser-cut illuminated pinball armor
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting System with Walking Dead-themed laser-cut shapes and 3-channel amplifier and tweeter for enhanced fidelity
- Limited Edition Mirrored Backglass
